input.quote: 10.1 On expiry or termination, Customer's right to access terminated subscription Services ends after any agreed transition period. Rights in accepted Deliverables, paid-up licences, Customer Data, and materials Customer owned or licensed independently continue according to their terms.
input.rationale: The Agreement has no post-termination transition assistance or data return/export obligation. Section 10 only ends access after "any agreed transition period" (with no obligation to agree or provide one) and addresses Deliverables and refunds; Section 15 covers processing but not return or deletion; Section 16.5 defers Customer Data to "Sections 11 and 15" and Section 11 does not exist in the document. Searches for transition, export, and deletion terms return nothing else. The rule therefore fails both the preferred and fallback positions (no assistance period, no export window, no certified deletion), so we insert a new Section 10.3 at the preferred position, with the 90-day fallback offered in the comment.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for export all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit clause because Section 10 refers to a transition period but contains no obligation to help us transition or to return our Customer Data (Section 11, cross-referenced in 16.5, does not exist). Our playbook requires up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter; we can accept 90 days of assistance if six months is an issue.
proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and Customer Data return/deletion obligation as new Section 10.3
